page.notes: Printed "Y" at the foot left is the gathering signature; "ficias:" at the right is the catchword, so the text ends at "in-". The word after "Papa," is hidden by a smudge; only "ecialis" is legible, so the lost letters are marked. The "+" in the right margin beside the Bellarmine quotation is a printed mark; its meaning is unclear. The reference marks x, y and * are read from the printed superscripts; the Sirmundus note's mark is uncertain. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "Thessalonicensem" as Thessalonicensem). Running head and page number are as printed.
